newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sika Q1 sales rise, sees higher '97 profit.
newsitem.headline: Sika Q1 sales rise, sees higher '97 profit.

text.p: Sika Finanz AG, a specialty chemicals firm, said net sales rose 25.4 percent in the first quarter of 1997 to 331 million Swiss francs and profits and sales for the full year should exceed 1996.

Sika said in a statement that it was confident for 1997 due to the efforts undertaken in speciality chemicals, successful new products and systems in clearly segmented markets and stable raw materials.
"We expect a further rise in sales and profits for 1997," Sika said.
In 1996 Sika's group net profit rose to 59.0 million francs from 46.6 million and net sales rose 4.7 percent to 1.41 billion.
The dividend will remain unchanged at 1.50 franc per registered share and nine francs per bearer share.
